legend: Imp is watching a documentary about cave painting.

Some numbers, carved in chaotic order, immediately attracted his attention. Imp rapidly proposed a guess that they are the remainders of division of a number n by all integers i from 1 to k. Unfortunately, there are too many integers to analyze for Imp.

Imp wants you to check whether all these remainders are distinct. Formally, he wants to check, if all ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/af9bf37ade74cbe9830bd367f7c2aeaf738ffd73.png), 1 ≤ i ≤ k, are distinct, i. e. there is no such pair (i, j) that:

![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d2e5b79d0b20795f51610e384d5973d0a2a091dd.png), where ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/cd0226f6733233da1ba1f4844ccc38fcceb2fd37.png) is the remainder of division x by y.
input: The only line contains two integers n, k (1 ≤ n, k ≤ 1018).
output: Print "Yes", if all the remainders are distinct, and "No" otherwise.
You can print each letter in arbitrary case (lower or upper).
note: In the first sample remainders modulo 1 and 4 coincide.

legend.ai: Imp 正在观看一部关于洞穴壁画的纪录片。
一些以混乱顺序刻下的数字立刻吸引了他的注意。Imp 很快猜测，这些数字是某个数 n 分别除以从 1 到 k 的所有整数 i 所得到的余数。然而，要分析的整数太多了，Imp 无法完成。
Imp 想让你检查所有这些余数是否互不相同。形式化地说，他想检查对于所有 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/af9bf37ade74cbe9830bd367f7c2aeaf738ffd73.png)，1 ≤ i ≤ k，它们是否互不相同，即不存在满足以下条件的数对 (i, j)：
![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d2e5b79d0b20795f51610e384d5973d0a2a091dd.png)，其中 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/cd0226f6733233da1ba1f4844ccc38fcceb2fd37.png) 是 x 除以 y 的余数。

input.ai: 唯一一行包含两个整数 n、k（1 ≤ n，k ≤ 1018）。

output.ai: 如果所有余数互不相同，则输出 "Yes"，否则输出 "No"。
每个字母的大小写可以任意（大写或小写）。

note.ai: 在第一个样例中，模 1 和模 4 的余数相同。
